name: Manatal
summary: Manatal prices three plans per user a month: $15, $35 and $55 when billed annually, or $19, $39 and $59 when billed monthly. A fourth Custom tier is quoted on request. Mass email campaigns draw on monthly credits and are switched off during the 14-day free trial.

facts.text: The candidate database page says applicant profiles are consolidated in one deduplicated location, and candidates can keep their own details current through a self-service portal.

Mass email campaigns reach only recipients whose opt-in status is Pending or Given, and the sending domain must be verified first. Monthly email credits are 200 on Professional, 1,000 on Enterprise and 5,000 on Enterprise Plus.
The sourcing page lists LinkedIn, Indeed, GitHub, SEEK Talent Search and Xing as sites its browser extension can pull candidate profiles from, and advertises posting to 2,500+ channels.
Manatal's pricing page lists SSO and API access under Enterprise Plus only.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $19 per user a month when billed monthly. Up to 15 jobs and 10,000 candidates per account.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $39 per user a month when billed monthly. Unlimited jobs and candidates, with workflow automation.

plans.name: Enterprise Plus
plans.notes: $59 per user a month when billed monthly. Adds SSO, user groups, API access and priority support.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Custom integrations, features and compliance. Priced on request.

hiddenCosts: The page does not label which price set is annual. The FAQ says $15, $35 and $55 are billed annually, so the higher figures are read as monthly billing.
Singapore tax residents pay 9% GST on top of the listed fees. The FAQ says customers elsewhere are not charged tax on fees.
AI Interviewer and the branded Guest Portal are named as add-ons with no price on the page.
Mass email campaigns and free job board posting are not available during the free trial. Extra email credits are arranged through support.
